claims: OS Terrain 50 provides a digital terrain model in grid and contour forms.
The grid supply is available in ASCII and GML 3.2.1 and must be interpreted using the product specification rather than as an untyped matrix.
Each grid height is calculated at the centre of its pixel.
The companion GML carries location, grid spacing and vertical-reference metadata for the ASCII supply.
Grid origin, row order, post spacing and axis interpretation must be applied before mapping a National Grid reference to a cell.
Per-tile XML metadata follows the GEMINI standard.
The horizontal reference system is British National Grid EPSG:27700 and temporal extent metadata is represented per tile.
Raster heights are located at pixel centres while contours and spot heights are separate feature representations.
A contour or spot-height feature must not be substituted for the exact grid-cell value requested for a candidate.

quality_guards: Do not interpret the ASCII lower-left or corner metadata as the value location without the pixel-centre rule.
Do not mix contour, spot-height and raster grid semantics.
Retain horizontal CRS, vertical reference, tile temporal extent and stated precision when sampling.
Fail closed until the official TQ29 archive bytes, header and the two distinct candidate cell values are captured.
evidence_digest_policy: GitHub remote blob SHA readback after publish
